SELECT e.course_id, e.id 
FROM enrollments e 
JOIN grades g ON g.enrollment_id = e.id 
WHERE g.score = (SELECT MAX(x.score) FROM grades x) 
ORDER BY e.course_id, e.id;

SELECT e.course_id, e.id
FROM enrollments e
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT course_id, MAX(score) AS max_score
    FROM grades
    GROUP BY course_id
) AS max_scores ON e.course_id = max_scores.course_id AND e.score = max_scores.max_score
ORDER BY e.course_id, e.id;
